observation_indicators.observable_fil: May owner, baseline, quality measure at review date ang trial; tama ang 20% tungong 5% na paghahambing; isinasaalang-alang ang workload at handover.
observation_indicators.observable_en: Specifies owner, baseline, quality measure and review date; correctly compares 20% with 5%; accounts for workload and handover.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ipinapahayag na tagumpay ang mas mababang total kahit bumaba o nakansela ang serbisyo.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Declares lower totals a success despite reduced or canceled services.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May owner, baseline, quality measure at review date ang trial; tama ang 20% tungong 5% na paghahambing; isinasaalang-alang ang workload at handover. Nagagawa kahit hindi pinapaalalahanan.
levels.kaya_na_en: Specifies owner, baseline, quality measure and review date; correctly compares 20% with 5%; accounts for workload and handover. Completes this without prompting.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Kumpleto ang plano ngunit raw total lang ang comparison; ipagamit ang bawat session o bawat 100 pahina.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Completes the plan but compares raw totals only; prompt for per-session or per-100-page measures.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ipinapahayag na tagumpay ang mas mababang total kahit bumaba o nakansela ang serbisyo.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Declares lower totals a success despite reduced or canceled services.
